content: For @nestjs/config env validation, Zod is now the 2025-2026 consensus recommendation over Joi for new TypeScript projects: infers static types from the schema (ConfigService becomes fully typed), clearer fail-fast error messages at startup ('DB_HOST: Expected string, received undefined'). Joi remains valid (used in official NestJS docs, richer standalone validation rule set) but requires maintaining types separately. Zod latest 4.6.2.
